libheif (1.23.6-1) unstable; urgency=medium

  * New upstream version 1.23.6
  * Various security fixes:
    - Fixes memory exhaustion in the OpenJPEG decoder plugin.
      See upstream commit c91d16e (GHSA-h4h8-qgvc-m7r2).
    - Fixes memory exhaustion in the uncompressed decoder with generic
      compression. See upstream commit 585607a (GHSA-fcmw-5764-7rq8).
    - Fixes CPU exhaustion in the unci decoder with generic compression.
      See upstream commit 5d35b98 (GHSA-6fqc-p7r8-2g36).
    - Fixes heap out-of-bounds read in libsharpyuv. See upstream commit
      8dc3239 (GHSA-q7mw-2fmm-5q94).
    - Fixes invalid bit depth reported for image handle. See upstream
      commit 770b0d8 (GHSA-vv35-6hxg-95x8).
    - Fixes null pointer dereference when decoding an image sequence.
      See upstream commit 2b87e15 (GHSA-8p2c-9wv4-rx4p).
    - Fixes applying image size limit with the FFmpeg decoder plugin.
      See upstream commit 9e2c938 (GHSA-86ch-j429-fpr2).
    - Fixes reachable assertion when decoding a grid image.
      See upstream commit 858398f (GHSA-3gwx-cjv4-jr74).
    - Fixes heap out-of-bounds read in the FFmpeg decoder plugin.
      See upstream commit 1d24f41 (GHSA-hqpw-h8p6-22q9).
    - Fixes use after free of an error message in the WebP/raw loaders
      of heif-enc. See upstream commit a1645b6 (GHSA-hvwh-xpj6-ph5x).
    - Fixes cases where decoded images could contain sample values above
      their declared bit depth. See upstream commit 6e7c728
      (GHSA-v5rj-g4wv-j5w3).
  * Unpackaged upstream version 1.23.5 contains the following security
    fixes:
    - Fixes memory exhaustion through container and bitstream image size
      mismatch. See upstream commit 6ce2bba (GHSA-v8qw-hwjv-44hw).
    - Fixes heap use-after-free and double free when encoding image with
      TAI timestamp. See upstream commit 45a40ca (GHSA-qwpf-5wf7-r996).
    - Fixes memory amplification through a JPEG 2000 pclr box. See
      upstream commit ba47ddd (GHSA-9c75-9g8r-4728).
    - Fixes heap out-of-bounds read in alpha compositing for uncompressed
      (unci) images. See upstream commits e379fd5 and 6f58ba3
      (GHSA-r7gr-2xm2-23wf).
    - Fixes incomplete OpenJPEG pre-decode security limits allowing
      unsafe decode through the public API.
      See upstream commit a44ad89 (GHSA-q492-cfcm-895h).
    - Fixes heap out-of-bounds read in the uncompressed encode.
      See upstream commit c727622 (GHSA-qfj5-c4pq-q998).
    - Fixes applying heif_security_limits when parsing a mini box or the
      av1C/hvcC blob embedded in it.
      See upstream commit 24219cb (GHSA-7pwf-qh74-p35w).
  * Enable kvazaar plugin on loong64 now that #1127385 is resolved.

 -- Joachim Bauch <fancycode@debian.org>  Sat, 10 Oct 2026 23:24:21 +0200

libheif (1.23.4-1) unstable; urgency=medium

  * New upstream version 1.23.4
  * Various security fixes (Closes: #1148137):
    - Fixes unbound parsing of iinf child boxes. See upstream commits
      2ebb06f, 19fd108, eb339b7 and 92b79c6 (GHSA-vg7w-rp49-4fc2).
    - Fixes unbounded recursion when checking reference cycles.
      See upstream commits b1e4d72 and 7538a4f (GHSA-xrp2-63fq-jm8q).
    - Fixes decoder deadlock through lock-order inversion. See upstream
      commit f8beb40 (GHSA-prgh-72vc-3xmc).
    - Fixes heap out-of-bounds read when encoding images with different
      luma and chroma bit depths. See upstream commit 51360e1
      (GHSA-fqpw-fj22-78w4).
    - Fixes memory leak in heif_track_get_next_raw_sequence_sample.
      See upstream commit 3d9c246 (GHSA-4rv4-953r-p24q).
    - Fixes heap out-of-bounds read in the WebCodecs decoder plugin.
      See upstream commits fb8d945 and 604d837 (GHSA-rhgw-q5g8-xjh2).

 -- Joachim Bauch <fancycode@debian.org>  Thu, 17 Sep 2026 21:27:18 +0200

libheif (1.23.3-1) unstable; urgency=medium

  * New upstream version 1.23.3
  * Fixes CVE-2026-84450, CVE-2026-84451.
  * Fixes heap buffer overflow (write) in the uncompressed (unci) mixed-
    interleave decoder when the two chroma components declare different
    bit depths. See upstream commit 9d3cd91 (GHSA-x8r2-mggj-j6wr).
  * Fixes decoder deadlock (DoS) via alpha-aux reference cycle.
    See upstream commit a83fd7b (GHSA-8fmq-r4pf-7m57).
  * Fixes heap out-of-bounds read in the YCbCr 4:2:0 to 16-bit interleaved
    RGB conversion. See upstream commit c37bf2b (GHSA-w7mc-p8jc-p853).
  * Fixes heap buffer overflow in the SVT-AV1 encoder plugin when encoding
    a high-bit-depth alpha channel.
    See upstream commits 0839585 and 5c3ed28 (GHSA-4jqm-2x34-6f6r).
  * Fixes heap out-of-bounds read when converting odd-height 4:2:0 frames
    of an uncompressed (uncv) image sequence to RGB.
    See upstream commit fe48abf (GHSA-4h82-g446-83fm).
  * Fixes out-of-bounds read in the RGB to YCbCr identity-matrix color
    conversion. See upstream commit 8008614 (GHSA-9rj8-5mp5-26c9).

 -- Joachim Bauch <fancycode@debian.org>  Thu, 03 Sep 2026 10:20:32 +0200

libheif (1.23.2-1) unstable; urgency=medium

  * New upstream version 1.23.2
  * Fixes heap buffer overflow in scale_nearest_neighbor() via duplicate
    alpha planes from nested iden/auxl items. See upstream commit f4fb8bd

    1fcada5, c664797, 328c4f9, 3d81d56, 578ab47 and 4dd71d7.
